'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]] launches multiple [[List of Shahed drones|Shahed]] [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] on [[Kharkiv]], [[Ukraine]], killing at least five people, including three [[rescue worker]]s, and injuring five others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-rescue-workers-killed-russian-drone-attack-ukraines-kharkiv-officials-say-2024-04-03/ (Reuters)]
**Russian appointed officials claim that [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] shelling has killed two [[civilian]]s and injured nine others in [[Donetsk]]. Separately, four people are killed in drone attacks in [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Russian-occupied]] [[Kherson Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-installed-officials-say-six-civilians-killed-ukrainian-attacks-2024-04-04/ (Reuters)]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] says that [[Ukraine]] will eventually become a [[NATO]] member. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-secretary-state-blinken-says-ukraine-will-be-nato-member-2024-04-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**Two [[West Papua National Liberation Army]] leaders, including [[Abubakar Tabuni]], are killed during a [[shootout]] with the [[Indonesian Army]] near the [[Grasberg mine]] in [[Mimika Regency]], [[Central Papua]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-papua-clashes-rebel-leaders-grasberg-mine-a427101fe9d7fbcbdbc527d5942fbee2 (AP)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Eleven security forces, including five [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Revolutionary Guards]], are killed in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province|Sistan and Baluchestan]], [[Iran]], during an attack against the Revolutionary Guards' [[headquarters]] by members of [[Jaish ul-Adl]]. Sixteen militants are killed in the ensuing [[shootout]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/militants-kill-5-iranian-security-officers-southeast-state-media-says-2024-04-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Former [[Al-Nusra Front]] [[emir]] [[Abu Maria al-Qahtani]] is assassinated in a [[suicide attack|suicide bombing]] in [[Sarmada]], [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]]. The [[Islamic State]] are accused of being behind the attack, which also injured several others at his house. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/top-iraqi-jihadist-killed-suicide-bombing-northwest-syria-2024-04-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[99 Cents Only Stores]] announces an orderly wind-down, closing all of its 371 stores in the United States beginning April 5. [https://www.newsweek.com/99-cents-only-stores-close-4-states-1887194 (Newsweek)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Shipping lanes and [[airspace]] in the [[Great Belt]] strait in [[Denmark]] are closed for several hours after a missile launcher malfunctions on the [[frigate]] {{HDMS|Niels Juel|F363|2}}. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2515458-belangrijke-deense-zeestraat-weer-open-na-problemen-met-raket-op-marineschip (NOS)] [https://www.cnn.com/2024/04/04/europe/denmark-shipping-strait-missile-launcher-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*Fourteen people are killed in a [[traffic collision|collision]] between a bus and a truck in [[Bolivia]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/truck-and-bus-collide-killing-14-in-bolivia-29d2bb60 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*Five foreigners are killed when a fire breaks out in an [[apartment building]] in [[Emirate of Sharjah|Sharjah]], [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/gulf/2024/04/06/sharjah-building-fire-leaves-5-dead-dozens-hospitalized (Al Arabiya English)] [https://gulfnews.com/uae/crime/sharjah-building-fire-some-residents-allowed-to-return-to-their-flats-1.102051391 (''Gulf News'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2020–2024 H5N1 outbreak]]
**Scientists from the [[Federation University Australia]] report that thousands of [[Adélie penguin]]s have been found dead in [[Antarctica]] amid an increase in [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] cases among wild bird populations. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/scientists-investigate-thousands-dead-antarctic-penguins-bird-flu-2024-04-04/ (Reuters)]
**Bird flu spreads to [[cattle]] herds in at least six [[United States|U.S.]] states, while a [[Dairy farming|dairy farm]] worker is infected in [[Texas]], becoming the second person to ever become infected with the virus in the United States. [https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2024-04-04/bird-flu-in-cows-and-a-human-worries-scientists-time-for-vigilance (Bloomberg)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula]], the [[Speaker of the National Assembly of South Africa|Speaker]] of the [[National Assembly of South Africa|National Assembly]] of [[South Africa]], is arrested and charged with corruption one day after resigning from office. [https://www.voanews.com/a/south-african-parliament-speaker-resigns-charged-with-corruption/7556627.html (VOA)]
*A man stabs the [[Governor of Murmansk Oblast]] [[Andrey Chibis]] at a meeting in [[Apatity]], [[Murmansk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. The attacker is arrested by police. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/man-stabs-governor-russias-murmansk-region-with-knife-2024-04-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Maltese presidential election]]
**[[Myriam Spiteri Debono]] is sworn in as [[President of Malta]], succeeding [[George Vella]] and becoming the third woman to hold the office. [https://timesofmalta.com/article/watch-myriam-spiteri-debono-arrives-sworn-11th-president-malta.1090397 (''Times of Malta'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*Researchers at the [[Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument]] in [[Arizona]], [[United States]], release the largest 3D map of the [[universe]] featuring more than six million galaxies. Using this map, researchers are able to measure the acceleration of the [[Expansion of the universe|expansion rate of the universe]] with unprecedented accuracy, detecting hints that the rate of expansion has been increasing over time. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2024/apr/04/biggest-ever-3d-map-universe-dark-energy-data-scientists (''The Guardian'')] [https://newscenter.lbl.gov/2024/04/04/desi-first-results-make-most-precise-measurement-of-expanding-universe/ (Berkeley Lab)]
